_comment: Editable extraction rules. All matching is local and deterministic. Add your own companies, fields and well prefixes here.
_well_exclude_comment: Matched well names that also match one of these are dropped, e.g. 'Dulang 3D' (a survey, not a well).
_typed_dates_comment: Each date attribute is filled ONLY from a date written right after one of its labels (anywhere in the PDF). CREATE_DATE uses date_labels above (cover pages).
_depth_comment: Depth values keep their written number; units map to m/ft. Depth references (MD, TVD, ...) are reported in evidence.csv, never in the UOM columns.
_interval_comment: Interval labels only match a range ('1200 - 2450 m'), so 'Sampling Interval: 0.1524 m' is ignored.
_depth_strict_comment: Depths without a written unit, or above these maxima, are kept as CANDIDATE evidence only (not exported).
_labelled_value_comment: Text attributes filled from 'Label: value' anywhere in the PDF.
_line_start_comment: Generic words that only count as a label at the start of a line ('Model: X'), never mid-sentence ('The Geobattery model: ...').
_sections_comment: A heading line matching reference_headings starts an excluded bibliography section (only if citation-like lines follow). It ends at a section_end_headings line or the end of the PDF.
_dates_concepts_comment: Publication dates go to evidence.csv only (never CREATE_DATE). The unlabelled 'first date on the cover' fallback for CREATE_DATE is off unless create_date_fallback is true.
_field_context_comment: '<Name> Field' phrases are never exported (only known_fields or a 'Field:' line are). They are listed as CANDIDATE evidence unless followed by one of these words or the name is a field_stopword.
_metadata_title_comment: PDF metadata titles matching this are ignored as placeholders.
_required_comment: If any of these are empty, EXTRACTION STATUS is PARTIAL.
_classification_comment: Rules are tried in order; the first match fills its 'set' columns (only cells still empty). A rule may give filename_regex, text_keywords (searched in Title + cover pages), or both (both must match). Leave empty until you have your organisation's reference lists.
_constant_comment: Same value for every PDF in a run, e.g. {"DATA_STORE_NAME": "...", "MEDIA_TYPE": "..."}. Only fills empty cells. DECRYPT_KEY and file-system columns cannot be set.
